title: Copilot Studio: SharePoint lists as an agent knowledge source
summary: Pass with qualifications: the roadmap facts, controls and documented list behaviour are supported. Clarify that an agent's monthly hard stop does not stop its agent flows, and acknowledge Microsoft's differing descriptions of content freshness and licensed usage.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the capability as working without manual data movement or complex integrations.
claims.quote: without manual data movement or complex integrations

Select the **Knowledge sources for agents** setting.
In the side pane, choose whether to sort by **Environment groups** or by **Environments**.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation specifically sets the Knowledge sources for agents rule.
claims.quote: Searched: "Knowledge sources for agents" "Power Platform API"; "Knowledge sources for agents" "PowerShell". Read pac governance and Rule Sets - Update Rule Set; generic rule parameters exist, but no identifier/value for this setting is documented.

claims.claim: The Knowledge sources for agents control page is marked preview.
claims.quote:
# Configure knowledge sources for agents in the Power Platform admin center (preview)
[This article is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]

claims.claim: The rule can also be configured per environment by choosing Environments.
claims.quote: This setting is available at both the environment and environment group level.

claims.claim: The SharePoint + OneDrive control offers None, All and Custom.
claims.quote:
**None**: Don't use any SharePoint and OneDrive sites as knowledge sources.
**All**: Use all SharePoint and OneDrive sites as knowledge sources.
**Custom**: Select which SharePoint and OneDrive sites agents can use.

claims.claim: Custom permits allowing or denying SharePoint and OneDrive sites by URL.
claims.quote: **Custom**: Select which SharePoint and OneDrive sites agents can use. Agents reference them in priority order, starting with the first URL. Select either **Allow** or **Deny** under **Access** for each URL.

claims.claim: The knowledge-source rule page does not specify how Custom treats individual list URLs.
claims.quote: Searched: "Knowledge sources for agents" "Custom" "list URLs". Read knowledge-sources-for-agents-rule and choose-knowledge-sources; Custom is described for site URLs, without individual-list URL matching semantics.

claims.claim: A group-level rule locks the corresponding environment-level setting.
claims.quote: if an admin sets the control at the environment group level, then it's distributed to the environment level and can't be modified there.

claims.claim: The agent monthly credit limit applies across Copilot Studio rather than exclusively to list knowledge.
claims.quote: Admins can set monthly consumption limits for each Copilot Studio agent, regardless of whether the environment uses prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: The documented route to agent limits is Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents, followed by selecting the agent, Set limit and Stop usage as explained in the note.
claims.quote:
On the navigation pane, select **Licensing**.
In the **Licensing** pane, under **Products**, select **Copilot Studio**.
On the **Summary** tab, select **Manage Agents**.

claims.claim: No documented API operation specifically configures agent monthly limits.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio agent monthly limit API PowerShell; bot monthly limit Dataverse entity reference; pac admin agent limit. Read capacity, manage-usage and govern-credit-consumption pages, pac CLI excerpts and bot reference excerpts; found no operation setting that limit.
